results.content: Data resource profile: the National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD). The National Health Insurance system of Taiwan was established in 1995 and covers more than 99.6% of the Taiwanese population; this system’s claims data are released as the National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD). After a change and update in 2016, the NHIRD is maintained and regulated by the Data Science Centre of the Ministry of Health and Welfare of Taiwan. * **Long-term exposure to air pollution and the risks of venous thromboembolism: a nationwide population-based retrospective cohort study**.
